podcast.title: Formation and Style (2013)
podcast.body: The Conjets formed in 2013 in Indiana, playing an ultra-accelerated, lo-fi punk rock with "martian" vocals. Their sound blended the energy of hardcore punk with influences from Power Pop and New Wave. "Una de estas bandas fue de conjets, formada en 2013 en Indiana, una banda que tocaba a Punx Rock Low Fy, ultra acelerado, con voces marcianas, que tenía mucho de ese hardcore punk, pero también de Power Pop y New Wave."

podcast.title: Distinctive Sound
podcast.body: The band's sound is characterized as resembling "gods reproduced at 45 revolutions per minute, on a record player that urgently needs a needle change," conveying a raw, high-speed, and somewhat distorted quality. "la banda suena como dios reproducidos a 45 revoluciones por minuto, en un tocalisco es que necesita un cambio de hoja urgentemente."

podcast.title: Foundational Role in Eckpank
podcast.body: The Conjets are considered a foundational band of the Eckpank genre, with their first LP, released by Tequeton Traejer, seen as a cornerstone of the movement. They were also positioned at the extreme end of the Eckpank spectrum in an influential 2018 Instagram diagram. "Sello que dito el primer LP de Comhets, considerado la pidrangular del género y que sigue irritando algunas de las bandas más interesantes de la nueva ola de la que ahora os voy a hablar."
